records.title: Hala Technical Report: Building Arabic-Centric Instruction & Translation Models at Scale
records.reason: The Hala report quantizes an Arabic-English teacher to FP8 and reports 2x throughput, but uses this to generate training supervision; the remaining contribution is model training and translation, not serving a deployed LLM.

records.title: Vehiclesim: realistic and 3D-aware video editing with one image for autonomous driving
records.reason: Vehiclesim is a two-stage video-editing pipeline for autonomous-driving simulation data and vehicle appearance control; its application is video synthesis, not LLM inference systems.

records.title: UCC: A unified cascade compression framework for vision transformer models
records.reason: UCC prunes and aggregates Vision Transformer tokens and reports substantial FLOP reductions, a concrete transformer-compression method. The evidence is for image-classification ViTs and does not establish transfer to LLM inference.

records.title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning-Driven Knowledge Distillation: Techniques, Challenges, and Applications
records.reason: The candidate's DOI/title are identified, but the registered publisher abstract could not be independently retrieved: IEEE Xplore direct document/abstract opens returned JavaScript-disabled anti-bot verification pages or Internal Error. Exact-DOI search surfaced secondary records, but no publisher abstract section was available. Keep borderline pending primary-source evidence.

records.title: MMFNet: A Mamba-Based Multimodal Fusion Network for Remote Sensing Image Semantic Segmentation
records.reason: MMFNet applies Mamba to multimodal remote-sensing image segmentation; the task-specific vision architecture is not an LLM inference-system contribution.

records.title: Spatially resolved rainfall streamflow modeling in central Europe
records.reason: The paper models rainfall and streamflow using neural networks for hydrology; this is an application model, with no LLM-serving or inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Audio Language Modeling using Perceptually-Guided Discrete Representations
records.reason: The audio language model uses discrete audio compression for audio generation/completion, but its contribution is audio-model quality and audio representation, not general LLM inference systems.

records.title: Towards Better Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models: A Position Paper
records.reason: This position paper discusses PEFT architectures and associated computational demands for LLMs, which may affect resource use, but supplies no concrete inference-time method or measurements.

records.title: High-resolution 3T to 7T MRI Synthesis with a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Model
records.reason: The hybrid CNN-Transformer synthesizes 7T MRI maps from 3T medical images; it is a medical-imaging application rather than an LLM systems paper.

records.title: DEPT: Decoupled Embeddings for Pre-training Language Models
records.reason: DEPT reduces embedding memory and communication during federated language-model pre-training; the abstract specifically describes a training framework and does not establish inference/serving savings.
